## Purpose
GitHub Actions workflow definitions for this repo. Owns the CI entrypoint that runs the test suite on every push to `main` and on pull requests.

## Files
- `test.yml` — defines the `tests` workflow: checks out the repo on `ubuntu-latest`, installs Node 22, sets a dummy `user.email`/`user.name` git identity (required because hook tests shell out to `git commit`), then runs `npm test`.

## Dependencies / collaborators
- Root `package.json` — the `test` script is the sole CI command; renaming or removing it breaks CI.
- `docgen.test.mjs` and hook code under `tools/` — these are what `npm test` exercises; tests that invoke `git` rely on the dummy identity configured here.

## Gotchas
- The `git config --global user.email/user.name` step is load-bearing, not cosmetic — hook/docgen tests perform real `git commit` calls and fail on a fresh runner without an identity.
- Node version is pinned to `22`; bumping it here is the only place CI's Node version is controlled.
